responses.ensemble_reason: I kept a single model, Logistic Regression. It had the highest mean AP (0.392, fold SD 0.030) and the lowest Brier (0.0633) and ECE (0.0188) among the strongest candidates, and none of the ensembles passed the gate. The weighted ensemble was about the same (AP 0.389) but more complex.
responses.validation_limits: Forward out-of-fold validation scored 2,155 rows over three periods. The earliest rows are warm-up with no outer predictions, and with only three folds the AP spread (about 0.03) is large compared with the gaps between candidates.
responses.calibration_limits: Calibration used 836 separate rows with only 78 defaults, which is small. The diagnostic was scored on the same rows used to fit the sigmoid, so it is optimistic, and it showed no clear gain (Brier 0.0765 raw versus 0.0781 sigmoid).
responses.capacity_fairness: The final threshold (0.169) flagged 11.4% of out-of-fold rows, within the 12% cap (largest period 11.7%). On the 2,500-row batch, 330 were eligible and 300 were flagged, so 30 were removed by the cap. False positive rates ranged from 6.3% (eastern) to 10.3% (western), so western applicants get more false alarms.
responses.explanation_scope: Day 4 explained a weighted LightGBM model, but my final choice is Logistic Regression, so those explanations do not directly describe the final model. I would redo the importance and reason codes on the final model.
responses.intended_use: This is a training exercise on fictional, synthetic data to practice model selection. It must not be used for real lending, credit decisions or any customer data.
responses.monitoring_plan: Each period I would check drift in key features such as bureau_score and dti, the share flagged against the 12% capacity, calibration (Brier and ECE) once outcomes mature, and false positive rate and recall by region.
responses.executive_summary_ar: اخترت نموذج Logistic Regression نموذجًا نهائيًا لأنه حقق أعلى متوسط AP وهو 0.392، مقابل 0.345 لـ LightGBM و0.353 لـ XGBoost، ولم يتجاوز أي تجميع شرط التحسن. حددت العتبة عند 0.169، فتم تمييز 11.4% من الطلبات ضمن سعة المراجعة البالغة 12%. هذا العمل تدريبي على بيانات اصطناعية ولا يصلح لقرارات حقيقية.
responses.executive_summary_en: I chose Logistic Regression as the final model because it had the highest mean AP (0.392, versus 0.345 for LightGBM and 0.353 for XGBoost), and no ensemble passed the improvement gate. With a threshold of 0.169, 11.4% of applications are flagged, within the 12% review capacity. This is a training exercise on synthetic data, not for real decisions.
